messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: Could you specify which chess tournament you’re referring to? For example, the World Chess Championship, the World Cup, the Chess Olympiad, or another event?
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was held in 2015, but the winner was Magnus Carlsen? Actually, the 2015 World Chess Championship was between Carlsen and Karjakin, Carlsen retained title. But maybe they mean "World Chess Championship 2015" or "Chess Olympiad 2015"? Or "FIDE World Cup 2015"? The question is ambiguous. We need clarification. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question. So respond asking which tournament.
